entities.name: Dev
entities.rationale: Handwritten green 'Dev' label at left, with an arrow pointing to CodeCommit. Represents the developer actor pushing code. Not inside any box.

entities.name: CodePipeline
entities.rationale: Icon labelled 'CODEPIPELINE' at top (AWS_Icon_10). Positioned above CodeCommit and CodeBuild as orchestrator; outside the VPC box. No explicit lines drawn to it.

entities.name: CodeCommit
entities.rationale: Icon labelled 'CODECOMMIT' (AWS_Icon_9). Outside the VPC box; receives arrow from Dev and points to CodeBuild.

entities.name: CodeBuild
entities.rationale: Icon labelled 'CODEBUILD' (AWS_Icon_8). Outside the VPC box; receives arrow from CodeCommit and has a green line going down to Registry.

entities.name: CloudFormation
entities.rationale: Icon labelled 'CLOUDFORMATION' (AWS_Icon_6). Outside the VPC box; annotated with handwritten '#100' and steps '1) ChangeSet 2) Approve 3) Execute'. Arrow points from it into the VPC box.

entities.name: Registry
entities.rationale: Icon labelled 'REGISTRY' (AWS_Icon_3), container registry (ECR). Outside the VPC box; receives arrow from CodeBuild.

entities.name: VPC
entities.rationale: VPC icon (AWS_Icon_7) sitting on the top edge of a white rectangular box. This box is a container that holds ECS, IAM and ALB.

entities.name: ECS
entities.rationale: Icon labelled 'ECS' (AWS_Icon_5). Drawn inside the VPC box.

entities.name: IAM
entities.rationale: Icon labelled 'IAM' (AWS_Icon_4). Drawn inside the VPC box next to ECS.

entities.name: ALB
entities.rationale: Icon labelled 'ALB' (AWS_Icon_2). Drawn inside the VPC box below ECS and IAM.

visual_connections.description: Green arrow from the handwritten 'Dev' label to the CodeCommit icon (developer pushes code).
Short green arrow from CodeCommit to CodeBuild.
Long green diagonal line from below CodeBuild down to the Registry (ECR) icon, with arrowhead at Registry (built image pushed to registry).
Green arrow from the right side of CloudFormation to the left edge of the VPC box (CloudFormation deploys the stack containing ECS, IAM and ALB).
Green line from the handwritten '1) ChangeSet' step list to the left side of the CloudFormation icon; an annotation link rather than a link between two entities.
